newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary ups 1997 soc sec gap forecast by HUF20bln.
newsitem.headline: Hungary ups 1997 soc sec gap forecast by HUF20bln.

text.p: Hungary's social security deficit is likely to overshoot the 13.5 billion target for 1997 by some 20 billion forints, government spokesman Elemer Kiss told a news conference.

"The central budget deficit will be in a better position in 1997 than planned, while the social security's position will be worse then planned," he told a news conference following the cabinet meeting which approved key 1998 budget draft figures.

Kiss added that the increasing deficit of social security was unlikely to affect the 1997 budget deficit target of 4.9 percent of the gross domestic product as the impact would be offset by the central state budget's better position.
He said the Constitutional Court's decision earlier this week to nullify certain social security contribution rules would decrease the social security's revenues by seven to eight billion forints.

In 1996, Hungary's social security deficit was 55 billion forints higher than the originally planned 17.8 billion, while the central budget deficit was some 100 billion forints less than the planned 233 billion forints.
